Both constituent families meet the stated K-g-frame bounds and the two displayed perturbation hypotheses, while the partition selecting Lambda_1 and Gamma_2 has zero energy on e2 although K*e2 is nonzero. Hence the wovenness conclusion is directly false.

value.rationale: Theorem 3.10 is a structural perturbation result meant to certify weaving from quantitative closeness. The counterexample shows that every printed hypothesis can hold while a weave loses an entire coordinate, so the failure concerns the main conclusion rather than a secondary constant. The rescaling mechanism explains why the defect is systematic and identifies a necessary normalization principle for any replacement criterion.
